title: Kicked Oozy Zanzibari Yogurt Pilaf
description: A diabetic-friendly fermented and gooey Brazilian meal prep dish featuring caraway seed. Deglazed with a fond of garlic and olive oil for added depth.
instructions: In a pan, lightly toast caraway seeds for about 1 minute.
Add olive oil and garlic cloves to the toasted seeds, stir until fragrant.
Stir in prunes and diced olives with olive oil. Mix well.
Combine whole wheat breadcrumbs with yogurt, mix evenly.
Gently fold the breadcrumb mixture into the garlicky prune and olive mixture until fully incorporated.
Transfer the pilaf to a greased dish, top with crumbled feta cheese.
Bake in preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for about 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
